subject: Analog Electronics
questionText:
If the value of source to drain voltage is VSD = 6 V and 
drain current is ID = 2 mA, then the value of RD and 
RS, respectively are 
 
(a) 5 kΩ, 2 kΩ 
(b) 3 kΩ, 4 kΩ 
 
(c) 4 kΩ, 3 kΩ 
(d) 2 kΩ, 5 kΩ
explanation: Practice Question from Analog Electronics DPP-04 (Analog Electronics Practice Sheet 04).
